purpose: Introduce a first-class bounded incident-repair lifecycle and reconcile construction lifecycle ownership so governance-only and already-merged defect repairs do not impersonate forward product selection or require routine meta-governance mutation.

lineage.outcome: Post-merge or governance defects can be repaired under one exact incident-bound authority without inventing a product node, reopening completed work, or allowing new product construction to masquerade as repair.
lineage.capability: Bounded incident-repair lifecycle and lifecycle-owner reconciliation

why_now: PR #211 repaired the trusted Steward bootstrap and was post-merge verified, but first use exposed two governance mismatches: already-merged/governance repairs cannot always bind a dependency-ready product node (#247), and ordinary governance incorrectly requires the immutable automation registry to mirror current construction lifecycle (#248). These must be repaired before serializing #210 or other product fixes.

implementation_contract.exclusive_mode: ACTIVE authority is either normal completion-graph construction or INCIDENT-REPAIR, never both.
implementation_contract.governance_repair: GOVERNANCE incident repairs authorize only governance/**, tests/governance/**, and the exact trusted Steward workflow path with product_code_allowed=false.
implementation_contract.merged_product_repair: MERGED_PRODUCT repair requires an exact target merge that predates the incident discovery main, and construction-sensitive repaired paths must already exist at that target merge.
implementation_contract.incident_truth: Every incident repair names a currently open repairable durable incident. An INACTIVE receipt cannot carry repair authority except an exact base-bound INCIDENT_REPAIR_CLOSURE transition.
implementation_contract.runtime_truth: governance/current_state.json owns construction lifecycle. automation_registry.json remains declarative actor/authority bounds and is not a live runtime-state source.
implementation_contract.trust: The ordinary governance checker and repair-authority helper become protected trusted surfaces so a candidate cannot self-weaken dependency, receipt, or repair-mode checks.

completion_proof: normal ACTIVE construction remains graph-node/dependency bound
GOVERNANCE repair passes with zero ACTIVE graph nodes and unchanged declarative automation lifecycle projection
MERGED_PRODUCT repair requires a pre-incident target merge and pre-existing repaired product paths
INACTIVE receipt incident ids cannot authorize a #206 repair except exact base-bound final repair closure
new product files cannot be introduced through MERGED_PRODUCT repair mode
candidate cannot mutate check_governance.py or the repair-authority helper without explicit meta-governance reopen
automation registry cannot reclaim runtime lifecycle ownership
exact-head governance, full regression and staged consumer smoke pass on Linux, Windows and macOS
substantive exact-head review is terminal before merge
next_selection_rule: After this governance repair is merged and post-merge verified, keep #206 repair work truthful under exactly one active receipt at a time; do not select unrelated ordinary work.
